# GFX100RF 1.13 firmware extract (static analysis, no camera)
# Source: GXUP0008.DAT, code stream at flash 0x860000/0xfa0000 (LZ 0x4000/v4)
# USB device controller: DesignWare USB3 (DWC3), base 0xffc0c000 (confirmed by
# register fingerprint; X-T5 main app has the same base)

## A 286-code property array from the firmware data section (count matches the
## measured 'advertises 286 in wireless tether'; not confirmed to be that mode's
## GetDeviceInfo set). 167 of these are unnamed. A separate 61-code array (not
## listed here) holds the bank-content D18F-D1A8 and RAW-conv D183-D187 codes.
